items.name: Sable's moth brooch
items.text: A tiny silver moth with wings of grey enamel, the clasp worn smooth by twenty years of thumbs. Sable has never sold it, even when starving.

items.name: Letter in a queen's hand
items.text: A single sheet, sealed and unsealed again, written in a slanting hand that has signed treaties. The ink has faded to the colour of dried blood.

items.name: Sable's songbook
items.text: A well-thumbed notebook of half-finished songs, margins crowded with doodles of moths. Sable pressed it into your hands without comment.

items.name: Set of silver lute strings
items.text: Wound silver wire in a paper wrapper. The sort of present a bard remembers.
